主要内容: On January 27, 2021, Kentucky Bancshares, Inc. and Stock Yards Bancorp, Inc. announced a merger agreement involving Stock Yards, H. Meyer Merger Subsidiary, Inc., and Kentucky Bancshares, Inc. The transaction is subject to regulatory approval and will be filed with the SEC as a registration statement on Form S-4, which includes a proxy statement for Kentucky Bancshares and a prospectus for Stock Yards. Shareholders are advised to review the documents for important information about the merger. The merger is expected to impact the financial services industry and the companies involved.
